notes.title: Are you ready? A new Update comes to Codename: Terranova
notes.notes:
We've heard your feedback and we are here to release a new update. 
It contains:
[list]
[*] A revision of the first three levels for increased playability
[*] New game progression system based on the Agent's rank
[/list]
